jot.definition:
n a brief (and hurriedly handwritten) note
n a slight but appreciable amount
v write briefly or hurriedly; write a short note of
jot.translation:
n. 少量, 稍许
vt. 略记, 摘要记载下来

jots.definition:
n a brief (and hurriedly handwritten) note
n a slight but appreciable amount
v write briefly or hurriedly; write a short note of
jots.translation: v. 匆忙记下( jot的第三人称单数 ); 草草记下, 匆匆记下

jott.translation: v. 略记;摘要记载下来

jotted.definition: v write briefly or hurriedly; write a short note of

jotter.definition: n. a small notebook for rough notes

jotters.definition: n. a small notebook for rough notes
jotters.translation: n. 笔记本( jotter的复数形式 )

jotting.definition: n. a brief (and hurriedly handwritten) note

jottings.definition: n. a brief (and hurriedly handwritten) note
jottings.translation: n. 简短的笔记, 略记( jotting的复数形式 ); 随感; 杂记

jotun.definition: n. (Norse mythology) one of a race of giants often in conflict with the Aesir
jotun.translation: n. 佐敦国际（挪威公司名）

jotunheim.translation: n. 巨人之家（北欧神话中的）

jotunn.translation:
n. (北欧神话中)巨人族的一员
[网络] 船中载满霜巨人
